meta.name: agent-protocol
meta.description: Inter-agent communication protocol for C-suite agent teams. Defines invocation syntax, loop prevention, isolation rules, and response formats. Use when C-suite agents need to query each other, coordinate cross-functional analysis, or run board meetings with multiple agent roles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义高管级智能体间的通信协议与协作规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建需要多个C级智能体协同工作的系统
copy.tagline_en: Define communication protocols and coordination rules for C-suite agent teams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building systems where multiple C-suite agents need to collaborate

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在高管角色间按协议互相调用:用 [INVOKE:角色|问题] 查询,按固定格式回应(关键发现、支持数据、置信度、注意事项),并强制防自调用、深度上限2、防循环。
howto.when: 当需要多个高管角色互相查询、协调跨职能分析,或召开多人董事会会议时触发。

say.text: 用 [INVOKE:cfo|招聘5名工程师对现金流的影响] 查询 CFO。
say.note: CFO 按协议返回结构化回答。

say.text: 让 CFO 和 CTO 互相查询,评估新功能上线的预算和工期。
say.note: 跨职能协调,受防循环规则约束。

say.text: 召开董事会会议,先独立分析再交叉讨论。
say.note: 隔离阶段禁止互相调用,之后恢复。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude lets C-suite roles query each other via [INVOKE:role|question], returns responses in a fixed format (key finding, supporting data, confidence, caveat), and enforces hard rules: no self-invocation, max depth 2, no circular calls.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need C-suite agents to query each other, coordinate cross-functional analysis, or run board meetings with multiple agent roles.

say_en.text: Query the CFO with [INVOKE:cfo|Impact of hiring 5 engineers on cash flow]
say_en.note: CFO returns a structured response per protocol.

say_en.text: Have the CFO and CTO query each other on the new feature's budget and timeline.
Run a board meeting: independent analysis first, then cross-pollination.
say_en.note: Isolation phase blocks invocations until later.
